experiences.name: Maruyama Park Cherry Blossom Viewing
experiences.description: Visit Kyoto's most famous cherry blossom spot, Maruyama Park, during peak bloom. The iconic weeping cherry tree is illuminated at night, but with a late Day 1 arrival, plan this for Day 2 morning onward. Families can enjoy hanami (flower viewing) picnics, street food stalls, and a relaxed atmosphere. Arrive early afternoon to secure a good picnic spot before crowds peak.

experiences.name: Senso-ji Temple and Nakamise Shopping Street
experiences.description: Explore Tokyo's oldest and most iconic Buddhist temple, Senso-ji, in the Asakusa district. Walk through the Nakamise shopping street lined with traditional crafts, snacks, and souvenirs — perfect for families. Since the flight arrives late on Day 1, schedule this for Day 2 morning when the temple grounds are less crowded and the atmosphere is most serene. Kids will love the fortune-telling omikuji slips.

experiences.name: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum and Park
experiences.description: A deeply moving and historically significant experience for families with older children. The Peace Memorial Museum chronicles the events of August 6, 1945, while the surrounding park features the iconic A-Bomb Dome and the Children's Peace Monument. This is one of Japan's most important historical sites and offers a powerful educational experience. Budget a full afternoon for the museum and park walk. Easily accessible via Shinkansen from Kyoto or Osaka.
experiences.location: Peace Memorial Park, Naka Ward, Hiroshima

experiences.name: Tsukiji Outer Market Food Tour
experiences.description: Dive into Japanese culinary culture at the Tsukiji Outer Market, still bustling with fresh seafood, tamagoyaki (sweet egg omelette), sushi, and street snacks even after the inner market relocated. Families can graze through stalls sampling tuna sashimi, grilled scallops, and matcha treats. Since Day 1 is lost to a late arrival, use Day 2 or 3 morning for this experience when vendors are freshest and most active. Budget approximately $20–$30 per person for tastings.
experiences.location: Tsukiji Outer Market, Chuo City, Tokyo

experiences.name: Nijo Castle and Nishiki Market Half-Day Family Tour
experiences.description: Combine a visit to the historic Nijo Castle — a UNESCO World Heritage Site famous for its 'nightingale floors' that squeak to alert of intruders — with a stroll through Nishiki Market, Kyoto's narrow five-block covered market nicknamed 'Kyoto's Kitchen.' Families will enjoy the castle's samurai history and the market's pickled vegetables, fresh mochi, and grilled skewers. This pairing fits comfortably into a half-day and stays well within budget. Schedule from Day 2 onward given the late Day 1 arrival.
experiences.location: Nijo Castle and Nishiki Market, Central Kyoto
